page.layout: One page of verse, one column, with the running head at the top and the page number at the top right. No margin notes, no footnotes, no catchword or signature.

p.i: Auctores scelerum rursus si in viscera regni Admittas, facilisque illorum audire querelas (Vt fert fama) paras, prisco q; in honore locare.
Parce tibi, nobisq; simul, communia utrosque Fata manent, prohibe instantem subitamque ruinam A regnis populisque tuis, nam te sine Ranis[?] Permissum nihil, At crimen fautore levatur.

Quid iuuat à vitiis Regnum purgasse, suaque E ditione procul sceleratos inde potenti Eiecisse manu, propria si denique culpa Restaurentur, & in multo maiore habeantur Respectu? è quibus heu lateri constanter adhaeret
Alter, ita excultus magicis virtutibus, ut se Scire canat quae vos semper fortuna manebit, Sic mentem atque oculos obiectis fascinat umbris Viribus inferni pollens & fraude parentis.
Alter ita est fidens, tantumque pudore remotus, Defunctum ut Regem, serpente nocentior omni, Non dubitet scriptis proscindere, & interea illi Hoc impune licet, nullo cohibente furores.
Quo tandem erumpet monstrosa licentia? Reges Sicne licet lacerare sacros, mortemque minari?
Jam, jam tempus erit Regü Rex maxime, mentem Dirigere huc, populumque tuum, regnumque tueri.

Quo res nostra loco, quae sit fortuna videmus: Vester honos agitur, mundi pulcerrima tellus Opprobriis vexata iacet, reliquisque pudori Gentibus est, miserere tui, miserere tuorum, Iura patrum, ritusque sacros, legesque avitorum Restitue, afflictae sua da medicamina genti, Non indigna peto, propriam quoque respice famam,

main_text.p: Hinweis: Vom Ende der Seite ist nichts weiter gedruckt.

page.notes: Two ornamental paragraph marks (¶-like signs) stand before the first lines of stanzas four and five and before stanzas one and two; they are printed ornaments, not words, and are left out. The verse is set in italic type throughout; the whole passage is marked as italic. "Ranis" (stanza two) is doubtful and marked [?]. The foot note above is not printed on this page and should be disregarded: the page has no footnote. Long s is rendered as plain s throughout. u/v and i/j are normalised as instructed (e.g. utrosque, levatur, Jam).
